questions.q: What does a 'waking' black hole signify?
options: It becomes dormant when there's no nearby matter.
questions.explain: 🌌 A 'waking' black hole means it has gone from a dormant state to being active again. It typically remains inactive when there's no material nearby. However, once it starts to consume matter like gas or dust, it 'wakes up' and shows powerful emissions! 🚀 Remember, they can take millions of years to wake up! ⏳

questions.q: What is India's goal in cocoa production by 2040?
options: Focus on importing cocoa from other countries
